Fig
12 )
The
ratio
of
average
displacement
to
territory
size
regressed
against
the

fraction
of
times
a
territorial
limpet
was
found
displaced .

Since
the
average
displacement
for
a
limpet
depended
on
territory
size ,

the
ratio
of
the
two
provided
a
normalized
measure
that
could
be

compared
to
the
frequency
of
limpet
displacements .
A
significant

negative
relationship
was
found .
A
territorial
limpet
that
moved
more

frequently
covered
less
distance
in
its
territory
each
time
compared
to
a

limpet
that
moved
infrequently ,
but
traveled
greater
distances
when
it
did
move .
